title: California franchisor financial capacity and assurance options
activity: California franchisor financial capacity and assurance options
affectedParty: Brand owner and responsible manager
applicability: Only the identified activity, relationship and cited primary-source scope.
requirement: DFPI requires a franchisor to demonstrate present ability to meet FDD/agreement obligations without prospective franchisee funds; otherwise initial fees are impounded. Its guidance identifies increased capital, a compliant surety bond, an adequate performance guarantee with the guarantor’s audited financial statements included with the guarantee in the FDD, or disclosed fee deferral until initial Item 11 obligations are completed AND the franchisee is open. These are conditional routes, not automatic approvals. Normally statements audited by an independent certified public accountant under generally accepted accounting principles and accountant consent are required.
